issuer: Caldova Investments Limited — responsible entity of Caldova Managed Portfolios
name: Caldova Managed Portfolio — Sustainable Growth
objective: To earn returns of CPI + 4.0% p.a. over rolling 7-year periods, before fees and taxes, while applying Caldova's environmental, social and governance (ESG) exclusions.
adminFeeNote: Caldova Super & Pension admin fee is charged separately on the whole account balance: 0.30% on the first $250,000, 0.15% on $250,000–$1,000,000, 0.05% on $1,000,000–$2,000,000, nil above $2,000,000, plus a $180 p.a. account-keeping fee.

returns.basis: Illustrative model returns, net of investment fees and costs, before admin fees and taxes.
returns.warning: Past performance is not a reliable indicator of future performance.

topHoldings.holding: Green & social bonds — AUD hedged (managed fund)

sectorNotes: Excludes fossil-fuel producers, tobacco, controversial weapons and gambling, and companies with serious UN Global Compact breaches.
Illustrative carbon intensity is about 45% below the unscreened benchmark.
The screens narrow the investable universe, so returns can differ noticeably from unscreened Growth in any year.
suitableFor: Investors seeking long-term growth who want ESG exclusions applied, can accept larger short-term falls in value, and have a timeframe of at least 7 years.
importantInformation: General information only — not personal financial advice. Caldova Managed Portfolios are fictional products used in the Wealth Team in a Day scenarios.
